title: HtmlFigure
responsibility: Renders the native figure element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlFigure.attributes
inputs.description: Native figure attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlFigure.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native figure element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlFigure
outputs.description: The actual native figure element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
